name: diagram-design
title: diagram-design
description: Produces 45 diagram types — architecture, sequence, ER/data models, flowcharts, Wardley maps, Sankey, Gantt and more — as self-contained HTML+SVG, with a style-guide gate that pulls theme tokens from a site URL or design system so diagrams match the brand.
why: The collection's only diagramming skill: no other entry makes technical or editorial diagrams, and its dependency-free HTML+SVG output is themed from the target's own tokens instead of generic AI styling.
